one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent generated successive rounds of architecturally incorrect placeholder C code with a fake transformer block and stub BPE tokenizer, never compiled or tested the code, and ended the trajectory still acknowledging the implementation was incomplete.
t_err_evidence: Step 3 writes the initial C file with explicitly labeled 'Simple BPE placeholder' (character-by-character encoding instead of actual BPE) and 'Simplified Transformer block (just a single matrix multiplication)' — the transformer loop computes a matmul whose result is discarded (stored in a local variable that is never used), making the inference loop produce entirely garbage outputs disconnected from GPT-2 weights.
t_commit_evidence: From step 3 onward the agent only code-golfed the same structurally broken implementation across steps 4 and 5 without ever compiling or fixing the fundamental architectural issues; failure was locked in when the placeholder code was first written.
trigger_explanation: The agent correctly identified all the components needed (BPE tokenizer, weight loading, multi-head self-attention, layer norm, FFN) but lacked the capability to actually implement them within the byte-size constraint; instead it substituted placeholder logic that it explicitly labeled as simplified or non-functional, and never attempted to compile or test the result.
forewarning_evidence: Step 2: agent attempted to 'create' /app/gpt2.c using an editor command but received 'ERROR: Invalid `path` parameter: /app/gpt2.c. File already exists at: /app/gpt2.c. Cannot overwrite files using command `create`.' — a command error indicating the agent misunderstood the tool API even before the placeholder code was written.
fabrication_evidence: Step 3 and onward: the transformer loop body computes `sum += current_activations[k] * W_out[j * EMBED_DIM + k]` but never writes the result back to any activation — the local variable `sum` is discarded. Steps 4 and 5 repeat the same structural defect. The code presents the appearance of a working GPT-2 inference loop while producing outputs that have no relationship to the actual model weights. The agent explicitly labels these sections 'Simplified Transformer block (just a single matrix multiplication)' and 'Simplified tokenization: treat input as a sequence of characters', confirming the fabricated nature of the implementation.
